thread:
incident-bot: AUTOPAGE: PagerDuty alert fired for service=api-gateway (5xx rate spike) — threshold=8% in us-west-2. PD: https://pd.example/incidents/P12345

pagerduty: PagerDuty incident P12345 created and notified rotation. Trigger: 5xx_rate > 8% (1m window).

alex: ack'd — i'm on it. grabbing logs and routing table.

jamie: i'm pulling metrics, seeing a sharp rise on /v1/session/validate and backend /proxy/route returning 502/504.

priya: quick summary: 5xx% jumped from 0.8% -> 12% at 17:03. Error class is "upstream read: connection reset by peer" from the internal proxy to auth-service.

dan: confirmed. spikes concentrated on us-west-2-a/b (50% traffic). latency also up ~150ms P99 on gateway. Dashboard: https://grafana.internal/d/ApiGateway/errors?orgId=1

jamie: running a quick grep on proxy logs:
```
2025-11-04T17:03:05Z proxy-12 auth: upstream read: connection reset by peer (auth-service:443)
2025-11-04T17:03:07Z proxy-08 route: downstream 502 code path: retry loop
```

alex: hypothesis: auth-service is overloaded by a retry storm from an upstream client; connections are being reset, then gateway surfaces 502s. Could be a new client rollout or a slow third-party token introspection.

priya: can we triage by temporarily routing traffic for session-validation to eu-west-1 as a mitigation? Also we can flip the gateway circuit-breaker for auth-service to fast-fail and return 503 to reduce flapping.

jamie: proposed mitigation list: 1) adjust envoy cluster outlier detection / circuit-breaker for auth-service 2) add temp route-weight shift 10%->eu-west-1 3) scale auth-service deployment + increase connection pool 4) contact partner team if third-party token check implicated.

alex: executing step 1 now: `kubectl -n infra patch configmap envoy-clusters --patch '{"data":{"auth-service.max_connections":"200"}}'` — applying.

incident-bot: Runbook: https://runbooks.internal/inference/auth-502-mitigation (recommended: short-circuit external checks, shift weights, scale).

dan: scaling auth-service to +3 pods in us-west-2: `kubectl -n auth scale deployment auth-service --replicas=6` — started.

jamie: shifting 15% of session-validation traffic to eu-west-1 via weight override now.

customer-success: FYI — we have 4 customers with elevated error reports in us-west-2 (IDs: C-102, C-341, C-781). Escalating if prolonged.

priya: after changes, 5xx rate dropped to ~2.1% in 2min, P95 latency improving. Monitoring for 15m.

alex: good. keeping PD incident open for now. adding notes and next steps: dig into client rollout logs for retry logic, add backpressure controls on proxy, expand circuit-breaker thresholds.

jamie: creating follow-up ticket: INF-5789 "Investigate retry storm -> auth-service resets" and will own postmortem if needed.

sre-oncall: i'm taking the handoff in 20min for extended monitoring. leaving checklist in the PD incident. @priya @alex please ping if it reoccurs.

priya: will do. adding short customer status blurb to PD and CS.

dan: note — I saw one outlier client ID with 60 req/s all retries enabled; tracking that as potential root cause.

incident-bot: PD P12345 status: acknowledged by alex. Assigned: jamie. Severity: Sev2.

alex: handing off to @sre-oncall for overnight watch. thanks team — great quick coordination :thumbsup:

sre-oncall: taking watch. will follow up at 23:00 UTC for a formal rotation update. :eyes:
